option_relations.rationale: Bronchiolitis obliterans is a distinct lung disease and not related to Churg-Strauss syndrome.
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a separate chronic inflammatory lung disease and not related to Churg-Strauss syndrome.
Bronchiectasis is a condition of permanent enlargement of parts of the airways of the lung, distinct from Churg-Strauss syndrome.
Diffuse panbronchiolitis (DPB) is a chronic inflammatory disease of the airways, primarily affecting the bronchioles, and is not related to Churg-Strauss syndrome.
